Overview

Thessaloniki is a city in Central Macedonia with a population of 1,012,297. Greece’s second city with a rich Byzantine heritage, vibrant waterfront, and renowned culinary scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
